# Welcome to dfolio' personal website ?

You can find on this site an overview of my activities as Associate Professor ([Dr. Habil](publications/thesis/folio2021hdr.qmd)) at [INSA Centre Val de Loire](http://www.insa-centrevaldeloire.fr/en){.url rel="noopener noreferrer" lang="fr"}.
These activities include my [researches](/research/research.qmd) and [teaching](/teaching/teaching.qmd).

You may also find some more personal (public) stuff that I would share on a regular basis.
